text: Implemented ValidationDesign and CrossFitDesign as distinct EvidenceDesign capabilities. Validation retains Resample4s coverage in its type; a sealed ExactOnceEvidence witness is the only route to validated one-location-per-SampleId OOF reconstruction, so Coverage and repeated Exact fail at compile time. CrossFitDesign has no public constructor: target-blind preparation requires exact-once outer validation, while target-aware preparation requires BoundNestedFold units and records inner-cross-fit preparation plus inner-fit/outer-refit scope. Nested outer and inner selections bind back to the source SampleId axis and remain separately inspectable. Generalization axis, schedule digests, seed, and seed domain participate in DesignIdentity. Focused JVM and Scala.js courts passed 4/4 each; warning and escape-hatch audits clean.
